proposals.before: He captured Tian Guang, the former king of Qi; Tian Guang, his chancellor; Xu Zhang, acting chancellor in charge of the defense; and Tian Ji, the former Jiaodong general.
proposals.after: He captured Tian Guang, the chancellor of the former King of Qi Tian Guang; Xu Zhang, the defending chancellor; and Tian Ji, the former Jiaodong general of Qi.
proposals.reason: Chinese 故齊王田廣相田光 identifies 田光 as chancellor of former Qi king 田廣; the idiomatic English wrongly treats the king as a captive and fails to distinguish the two men.

proposals.before: Among his prisoners were the former King of Qi, Tian Guang, Chancellor Tian Guang, the defending chancellor Xu Zhang, and the former Jiaodong general Tian Ji.
proposals.after: He obtained the former King of Qi Tian Guang's chancellor Tian Guang, his defending chancellor Xu Zhang, and the former Jiaodong general of Qi Tian Ji.
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise misreads the capture list as including the king rather than his chancellor 田光.

proposals.before: His fief income was Pingyang with 16,630 households, titled Marquis of Pingyang, removing his previous fief income.
proposals.after: His fief income was Pingyang with 10,630 households, titled Marquis of Pingyang, removing his previous fief income.
proposals.reason: 萬六百三十戶 is 10,630 households, not 16,630.

proposals.before: His son Dai succeeded as marquis.
proposals.after: His son Shi succeeded as marquis.
proposals.reason: 子時 is the name Shi (時); 代侯 means succeeded as marquis, not a personal name Dai.

proposals.before: Dai married Princess Pingyang, fathering son Xiang.
proposals.after: Shi married Princess Pingyang, fathering son Xiang.

proposals.before: Dai fell ill and returned to his state.
proposals.after: Shi fell ill and returned to his state.

proposals.before: Xiang married Princess Chang Wei, fathering son Zong.
proposals.after: Xiang married the Elder Princess of Wei, fathering son Zong.
proposals.reason: 衛長公主 is the Elder Princess of Wei, not "Princess Chang Wei".

decisions.reason: 得故齊王田廣相田光 names captives starting with chancellor 田光 of former Qi king 田廣, not the king himself; the proposed list restores that parse and keeps 守相許章 and 故齊膠東將軍田既.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 得故齊王田廣相田光，其守相許章，及故齊膠東將軍田既

decisions.reason: The literal likewise misreads 故齊王田廣相田光 as capturing both king and chancellor; 得 takes 相田光 (and then 守相許章, 將軍田既) as the objects obtained.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 得故齊王田廣相田光，其守相許章，及故齊膠東將軍田既

decisions.reason: 食邑平陽萬六百三十戶 is 10,630 households (萬 + 六百三十), not 16,630; the proposed numeral matches the Chinese and the idiomatic reading.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 食邑平陽萬六百三十戶

decisions.reason: 子時代侯 parallels 子奇代侯: 時 is the personal name Shi and 代侯 means succeeded as marquis, so Dai is a false name from misreading 代.
時尚平陽公主 continues the subject 時 (Shi) from the prior sentence; Dai is not in the Chinese.
時病癘，歸國 likewise has 時 as Shi; replacing Dai with Shi corrects the same misread personal name.
衛長公主 is the Elder Princess of Wei (衛 + 長公主), not a personal name Chang Wei; the proposed title matches the Chinese and the idiomatic rendering.
